dispatch.description: Dispatch topics for worker-local discussion, planning and implementation
dispatch.template:
Act as the dispatcher from `docs/agents/protocols/parallel.md` exactly, for these topics:

$ARGUMENTS


A successful launch must also pass the native session visibility checks in Protocol parallel.
Codex workers are independent interactive tasks on the shared app-server daemon and appear in
`codex agents`; do not launch them with `codex exec` or describe them as parent-owned subagents.
Claude workers appear in `claude agents`; OpenCode workers use the UI's shared session service.
Report the worker names and how to open their existing conversations for requirements and review.

implement.description: Implement an approved plan following docs/agents/protocols/implement.md
implement.template:
Follow `docs/agents/protocols/implement.md` exactly for the plan:

For a registered worker, require explicit plan approval in this worker session, reuse its
assigned worktree, and maintain lifecycle through `scripts/worker.py update`. Stop uncommitted
at the separate commit review gate; dispatch/resume never grants approval.

$ARGUMENTS

inbox.description: Add an idea or TODO to docs/agents/inbox
inbox.template:
Add a note to `docs/agents/inbox/` for the idea below, following `docs/agents/inbox/README.md`
and the template `docs/agents/templates/inbox.md`. Check existing notes first and extend one
instead of duplicating it. Do not implement anything and do not create a branch or commit — just
write the note and show its path.

$ARGUMENTS

lightweight.description: Small change without a plan, following docs/agents/protocols/lightweight.md
lightweight.template:
Follow `docs/agents/protocols/lightweight.md` exactly for this change:

For a registered worker, reuse its assigned worktree, maintain lifecycle through
`scripts/worker.py update`, and stop uncommitted at commit review in this worker session.
If planning is required, discuss requirements and obtain plan approval here before implementation.

$ARGUMENTS

plan.template:
Follow `docs/agents/protocols/plan.md` exactly for this change:

If this is a registered worker, reuse its assigned branch/worktree, maintain its lifecycle
through `scripts/worker.py update`, and discuss requirements and obtain approval here.
Dispatch is not plan or commit approval.

$ARGUMENTS
